documents.text: George King-Hall Admiral Sir George Fowler King–Hall, KCB, CVO (14 August 1850 – 10 September 1939) was a senior officer of the Royal Navy. King-Hall was born on 14 August 1850 as the second surviving son of Admiral William King-Hall and Louisa Forman. His younger brother was Admiral Sir Herbert King-Hall. He joined the Royal Navy as a cadet in 1864 and during his time as a midshipman served aboard from 1866 to 1867. King-Hall was promoted to commander in 1885, and was captain of the sloop from 1877 to 1889, during which time the ship was responsible for securing
